content: लुट् I. €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (लोटते) .²1 To resist, repel, oppose. .²2 To shine. .²3 To suffer pain. --II. €10 <ab>U.</ab> (लोटयति-ते) .²1 To speak. .²2 To shine. --III. €1. €4 <ab>P.</ab> (लोटति-लुट्यति) .²1 To roll, wallow on the ground; <ab>cf.</ab> लुठ्. .²2 To take away, rob, plunder (perhaps for लुण्ठ् or लुण्ट्).
लुट् A technical term used by Pāṇini to denote the First or Periphrastic Future or its terminations.
